text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Why was she the one entrusted with it? To 
explain that, I think we need to go back 
quite a long time.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
The only part in my memories that's 
clouded by haze ...all the way back to a 
certain time in the Classic year.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I remember up to January of that year. How 
I dove headfirst into the racing world I'd 
always loved.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"I found rivals to compete with. I even 
won 'Best Junior Class Umamusume'. 
...Every day was so much fun."

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Just running at the front felt amazing. I 
wanted to race with everyone so much more.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
“One day, though, one after another, 
everyone refused to run alongside me.”

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sorry. If I run with you, I'll lose 
my future..."

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
With her head cast downward, she spoke of 
her dream. That one day, she would win a 
graded race and become a proud daughter 
worthy of her mother's praise.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"And then she asked me, 'I'll do anything 
if it means my dream can come true. What 
kind of dream do you have, Maruzen-san?'"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
—I just couldn't understand those 
feelings.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I don't have a dream. I just want to race. 
I just want to compete with someone and 
become the wind.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I could hear the crowd's voices. "You can 
become a Derby Umamusume!" "No way, you 
might even win the Grand Prix!"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Still, I couldn't help but wonder what 
lay at the end of continuing to run like 
this. Even as running cost me things so 
precious to me."

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
—*Snap*. I heard the sound of something 
breaking inside me.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I don't remember much of what happened 
after that. I've even forgotten the exact 
reason why I gave up on the Classic Triple 
Crown path entirely.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
As time went on, before I knew it, I had 
more friends, and my days became so much 
more fulfilling.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Still, every time someone spoke about the 
Derby, that hazy cloud grew just a little 
bit bigger.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"If only I'd aimed for the Derby... If 
only I could've run in it... Feelings of 
regret like that kept swirling around in 
my head."

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
...Before I knew it, the Derby had become 
a dream that slipped beyond my grasp.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: And as for me.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I met a girl who told me, "I want to be 
just like you."

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Not sparkling, but with a fierce, burning 
glare in her eyes. The moment I saw those 
eyes of hers, I felt something fateful—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
—I, too, found myself wishing for her to 
become like that.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
...Chiyo-chan. In my place, go win the 
Derby, okay?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Oh, looks like that Umamusume who looks up 
to you and strives to follow your example 
is running too.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, isn't she adorbs~♪ She's such a 
babe, you could tell even from a mile 
away!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, Chiyo-chan. Give it your all for my 
sake too... and have lots of fun.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"...Are you really going to pass the 
torch, Maruzen?"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, I've entrusted it to you. My 
dream. And myself, too.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...! Maruzen-san.

As I watched Sakura Chiyono O after 
sending her to the paddock, something 
seemed to click in her... and a focused 
expression returned to her face.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"I'll definitely take the Derby today. 
...For your sake, too."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: All three of you are here now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I made it in time, too. To the "now" 
where you all compete.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I have my limits. Yet it is precisely 
because of those limits—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I have long been prepared to give up 
everything. For this... very moment.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...Right now.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Me too, just now. I'm glad today's Derby 
was my Derby.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
It is because I came to compete against 
the two of you that I was able to 
continuously forge myself into someone 
strong.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...Because I didn't want to lose to you 
all. So I could get strong... for real.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I will surpass all of you and prove that 
my conviction is stronger than anyone's.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I'll prove that the special feelings 
Maruzen-san passed on to me are stronger.
